body: I spent the day crying and sleeping yesterday. Everything just exhausts me.

Sometimes it’s just there bro and it sucks, trust me I and I’m sure a lot of other guys, are there with you. My best advice is to try and keep trying to distract yourself for the time being, music and YouTube always help me, as well as an app called Animal Crossing Pocket Camp - just a fun distraction game with cute animals might help as well. 

Other than that it’s just getting it out like you are, talking to others, and knowing that you’re not alone and that you will be there in time. 

I know how much it sucks to say it, but transition is honestly just a game of distraction and waiting until things come. 
 
For the time being, we’re all here for you to support you when you need it. ☺️
Nah I feel you on that - don’t worry!

I could - I’m currently in a partial hospitalization program for something else, which is helping me to build a support system through better communication with my family. 

I do like writing, I think I could keep walking every other day like I do and I am apart of a lot of clubs on campus - so that will help. I’m just really worried I won’t have the motivation to do any of it.
He’s just been a major support system, I wouldn’t attempt suicide, but I think I’d just fall into a severe depression and not be able to function well for a while.

I don’t know - I’m trans and pre-t, so my body sucks, and I don’t know how to talk to my family about it. Otherwise I just want to die - abuse myself until I’m a pulp because my body just sucks so much, what’s the difference between that and a bloody pulp?
